data.title: About your page.
items: How much does a page cost?
Nothing. Pages are free; Catch only takes a fee on paid tickets sold through it.
Why is my club already listed?
Catch lists organisers from public sources so guests can find them. Claim the page and it’s yours to edit, or ask us to remove it.
Can I show events I run on other sites?
Yes. They appear on your page as tiles that link out to where people book them.
Yes. Your reply shows under the review on your page and on the event.
Where do I edit my page?
In the Catch Host app, on iPhone, Android or iPad.
